The launch-process result would be more persuasive if a reader knew what changed and how launch success was defined.

gaps: The Skills section says up to 45 direct reports, while the Novara description names a 45-person organization without specifying its reporting structure.

The launch revamp gives several results but does not describe the process change, leaving readers to wonder what you decided to alter.
